content:
The image shows a coffee leaf with distinctive circular brown lesions featuring lighter tan/gray centers and darker brown margins, surrounded by yellow halos. This "eye-like" appearance is the hallmark of Brown Eye Spot (Cercospora coffeicola). Coffee rust (Hemileia vastatrix), in contrast, presents as orange/yellow powdery pustules typically on the leaf underside, which is not what's shown here.
